recent_elapsed_events: Raden writes down the three requested workstreams and treats them as a linked crisis-relief project rather than ordinary concert booking.

Raden identifies a factual dependency: current runtime knowledge only establishes that several large evacuation groups moved toward the Jura/Tempest direction, not that all intended recipients are confirmed inside Tempest. He refuses to dispatch a fully loaded caravan blindly and proposes immediate confirmation through Free Guild, courier, merchant and Tempest-facing channels while provisionally sourcing wagons, drivers, guards and relief goods.

Raden says a message can be dispatched immediately to Tempest authorities/Free Guild or other receiving contacts asking them to identify Eurazania evacuee locations, approximate needs and a receiving point; the promise of help should be conditional on locating the recipients rather than falsely claiming a confirmed destination.

Raden considers a charity concert operationally plausible in Dwargon: venue, permits, staff, suppliers, publicity, ticket/donation handling and transparent relief accounting can be organized. No venue or date is yet booked.

Raden flags that Carrion's death is currently public belief/presumption, not confirmed proof. He will not print 'heroically fallen' as an objective fact unless Arlequino explicitly chooses to use rumor-level wording or later obtains confirmation. Safer public wording would honor the victims, destroyed capital and 'presumed fallen/missing Beast King Carrion' or omit a definitive death claim.

Rena supports moving quickly but adds that a written estimate and separation of relief funds from family money are needed before substantial spending. No money has yet changed hands and Raden is still not formally hired.

Raden says he can take the coordination role in principle if Arlequino gives him authority to begin inquiries and provisional holds; final compensation, expense authority and public wording still require agreement.
